project_title: Global Streaming Performance and Cross-Platform Market Penetration Forensic Analysis

cardinality_defense_plan.dimension_aggregation_strategies: Generate 'dim_artist' by grouping artist-level attributes (count, genre/style indicators) ensuring a 1:1 mapping to the fact table's unique surrogate ID; use 'MAX' aggregation for binary status flags to avoid unintended multiplication.
cardinality_defense_plan.entity_resolution_and_key_cleaning: Sanitize 'streams' column by coercing non-numeric strings to null/zero; perform trim and casing normalization on 'track_name' and 'artist(s)_name' before generating MD5 hash-based surrogate keys.
cardinality_defense_plan.relational_join_sequence: Start with fact_table (left); join dim_artist on surrogate_id (1:1); join dim_time (release date hierarchies) on date_key (1:1); all joins must be Left-Outer to preserve forensic integrity of non-matched events.

assertion_gates: assert len(final_fact) == len(initial_fact), 'Row count mismatch: Cartesian duplicate explosion or row loss occurred!'
assert 'streams' in final_fact.columns, 'Missing expected dimension features!'

dax_measures: Rate / Percentage % = DIVIDE([Target Events Count], CALCULATE(SUM('spotify-2023'[streams]), ALL('spotify-2023')))
Total Financial / Operational Friction Loss ($) = SUMX('spotify-2023', [market_friction_penalty])
